proposed_headline_claim: George V Bridge closure causes a 24.7-second delay for city commuters
potential_overstatement_risk: Conflates unweighted OD node pairs with commuters; conflates static free-flow shortest-path delta with congestion delay; ignores that it affects only South->North travel.
scientifically_safe_portfolio_wording: In a static free-flow routing model of central Glasgow, severing the northbound King George V Bridge increases shortest-path free-flow traversal time by a mean of +24.74 s (+253.7 m) across 69,693 still-reachable South-to-North OD node pairs, while leaving North-to-South routing unaffected.

proposed_headline_claim: Spatial cross-consistency solves univariate blindness with 31.6% recall at 5% FDR
potential_overstatement_risk: Conflates univariate missingness PR-AUC (0.42-0.58) with spatial PR-AUC (0.1035); confuses 5% validation False Positive Rate (contamination c=0.05) with 5% False Discovery Rate (actual FDR is 92.9% at that threshold).
scientifically_safe_portfolio_wording: Bivariate spatial cross-consistency tracking provides an effective filter against shared corridor-wide flow drops and raises PR-AUC from 0.012 to 0.1035 on -50% calibration drift, but achieves an operational recall of 4.96% at 1% FPR and 35.51% at 5% FPR, meaning subtle localized drifts still require multi-hour persistence filtering.

proposed_headline_claim: Kingston Bridge closure strands 4,125 cross-river commuters without a route
potential_overstatement_risk: Falsely implies real-world drivers are physically trapped; ignores that unreachable destinations are northern motorway mainline stubs severed by the 55.865N bounding box.
scientifically_safe_portfolio_wording: Under M8 Kingston Bridge closure, 4,125 South-to-North OD node pairs (3.73%) lose connectivity strictly due to geographic study boundary truncation at 55.865N, which excludes Charing Cross on-ramps and regional bypasses (M74, Clyde Tunnel).

proposed_headline_claim: The SCOOT dataset spans 35,064 hourly UTC timestamps across 4 years
potential_overstatement_risk: Raw CSV data is timezone-naive local wall-clock time (GMT/BST), not explicit UTC. Missing hours at UK DST transitions confirm local logging.
scientifically_safe_portfolio_wording: The dataset covers 35,064 calendar hours (2019-2023) reindexed to a continuous timezone-naive hourly calendar, with 1,420 missing hours per sensor forensically traced to UK Daylight Saving Time clock shifts and an August 2023 municipal maintenance gap.

proposed_headline_claim: The road graph accurately routes traffic through central Glasgow junctions
potential_overstatement_risk: Node-based Dijkstra routing does not enforce 51 cataloged OSM turn restrictions, slightly underestimating urban traversal resistance at complex junctions.
scientifically_safe_portfolio_wording: The road network preserves dual-carriageway centerlines (1,932 unique links) and grade-separated bridge ramps without planar flyover snapping, while operating with the known simplification of omitting micro-level turn restrictions in node-based routing.

proposed_headline_claim: Machine learning models detect traffic sensor faults with high accuracy
potential_overstatement_risk: High PR-AUC (>0.88) applies to severe dropouts and large offsets; subtle calibration drifts (±15% to ±30%) remain undetected by all univariate models.
scientifically_safe_portfolio_wording: Standard time-series anomaly detectors (LOF, Seasonal ESD, Isolation Forest) reliably flag sudden zero dropouts and large step offsets, but exhibit near-zero recall on insidious multiplicative calibration drifts (±15% to ±30%).

proposed_headline_claim: The Observability Index measures critical infrastructure vulnerability
potential_overstatement_risk: Index is an exploratory topological formulation sensitive to subjective weights (alpha, beta, gamma), not an established civil engineering risk standard.
scientifically_safe_portfolio_wording: An exploratory topological observability index combining edge betweenness centrality and sensor proximity was formulated to prioritize unmonitored links, with rank sensitivity analyzed under varying weight configurations.

proposed_headline_claim: Glasgow Bridge closure disrupts cross-river travel in both directions
potential_overstatement_risk: Assumes bidirectional symmetry; in reality Glasgow Bridge is exclusively southbound and causes zero disruption to northbound travel.
scientifically_safe_portfolio_wording: Glasgow Bridge operates as an exclusively southbound arterial couplet; severing it reroutes 30,488 North-to-South OD node pairs (+9.82 s mean, +136.1 m) while causing zero change to South-to-North travel.
